io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup
Remote control of LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth Low Energy, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library.

    PoweredUpPort
    An external port of a Powered Up hub, printed on the hub as A to D: it takes a motor or an external sensor.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    RemotePoweredUpHub.enableSensor(PoweredUpPort port, int mode)
    Asks the hub to report every change of mode of the motor or sensor on port, for RemotePoweredUpHub.readSensor(PoweredUpPort) to return.
    PoweredUpMotor
    RemotePoweredUpHub.getMotor(PoweredUpPort port)
    The motor on the external port port (A to D), as an EncoderMotor.
    LinkedMotors
    RemotePoweredUpHub.linkMotors(PoweredUpPort portA, PoweredUpPort portB)
    Pairs the motors on ports portA and portB into a LinkedMotors pair, so one call drives both in sync, as for a two-motor vehicle.
    int
    RemotePoweredUpHub.portDevice(PoweredUpPort port)
    The I/O device type the hub reported (Hub Attached I/O) for the external port port (PoweredUpPort.A to PoweredUpPort.D), one of the DEVICE_* constants or another protocol type id, or 0 if nothing is attached, the hub has not reported it yet, or port is out of range.
    int
    RemotePoweredUpHub.readSensor(PoweredUpPort port)
    The latest value reported by the port RemotePoweredUpHub.enableSensor(PoweredUpPort, int) subscribed to, or 0 before the first report.
    int
    RemotePoweredUpHub.readSensorValue(PoweredUpPort port, int index, int bytesPerValue)
    The index-th value of the latest report of the port RemotePoweredUpHub.enableSensor(PoweredUpPort, int) subscribed to, as a signed integer of bytesPerValue bytes (1, 2 or 4, little endian).
    int
    RemotePoweredUpHub.sensorReportCount(PoweredUpPort port)
    How many reports the hub has sent for port since RemotePoweredUpHub.enableSensor(PoweredUpPort, int) subscribed to it, counting repeats of an unchanged value, so a program can measure how often the hub reports.
    int
    RemotePoweredUpHub.sensorReportSize(PoweredUpPort port)
    How many value bytes the latest report of port carried (at most 16), 0 before the first.
